breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification resolved the mass/volume conservation violation. Instead of specifying two different flow rates (0.01 and 0.02 m³/s), it correctly uses a single volumetric flow rate of 0.01 m³/s for the constant-area pipe, which implicitly enforces Q_in = Q_out = 0.01 m³/s, consistent with the ground truth.
